# Mundo Ferretero

> Mundo Ferretero is a hardware and construction-materials store in Santiago Atitlán, Sololá, Guatemala.

Mundo Ferretero sells construction materials and hardware including cement, block, PVC pipe, orange PVC conduit pipe, bathroom fixtures, steel and accessories. Product availability and prices can be confirmed by WhatsApp or telephone.
